subgoals.title: 承認済みフィードバックの安全なGitHub返送を一回実行する
acceptanceCriteria: Implement a bounded, opt-in, one-shot feedback uploader that uses the existing GitHub CLI authentication and a pinned repository and branch; send only newly generated allowlisted goal-feedback JSON with Node.js standard libraries, without launching Codex or invoking paid APIs.

Require complete recorded human-review evidence and an unchanged LIVE state during preparation; reject unexpected remote paths, malformed or sensitive fields, duplicate uploads and API failures without modifying goal-state-live.json or overwriting unrelated remote files.

Add offline tests with stubbed GitHub CLI responses covering first upload, duplicate, pending review, unsafe JSON and failed network or remote verification; keep all existing regression tests passing.
